title: ShopEasy Marketplace
problem_statement: Online shopping has grown significantly but many buyers and sellers still face challenges in the e-commerce space. There is a big opportunity to create a better marketplace experience that benefits both sides. ShopEasy aims to make online shopping easier and more enjoyable for everyone involved.
target_users: Online shoppers who want a better shopping experience
Small business owners who want to sell their products online
People who are new to online shopping
user_stories: As a buyer, I want to browse and purchase products easily so that I can shop without frustration
As a seller, I want to list my products and manage my store so that I can reach more customers
As a buyer, I want to see product reviews so that I can make informed purchase decisions
As a seller, I want to track my orders and inventory so that I can manage my business effectively
acceptance_criteria: Buyers should be able to browse and purchase products without issues
Sellers should be able to create and manage product listings easily
The checkout process should be smooth and secure
Both buyers and sellers should have a good overall experience

success_metrics.target: Growing number of transactions over time
Sellers are happy with the platform
Good repeat purchase rates from buyers

risks_open_questions: Competition from Amazon and other established marketplaces will be significant
Building trust with new buyers and sellers from the start
Payment processing and fraud prevention need to be addressed
out_of_scope: International shipping in the first version
